en.headline: Paediatric expert warns colder weather may prolong flu season for children
en.dek: Dr Mike Kwan said the current flu wave could merge with the winter season as temperatures drop next week, and urged parents to vaccinate children soon.
body: A leading paediatric infectious diseases specialist has warned that cooler weather expected next week could prolong Hong Kong’s current flu season and raise the risk of severe cases in children.

Dr Mike Kwan, president of the Asian Society for Paediatric Infectious Diseases, said on Saturday that if infection numbers remain high, critical cases would rise in tandem. He noted that the city has already recorded 29 severe paediatric influenza infections this season, two of them fatal.

“Since the weather is going to get more cold, and also we are going into the winter season, I really worry that the current flu season will merge with the winter flu season,” Kwan said. He urged parents whose children had not yet received this season’s influenza vaccine to arrange vaccination as soon as possible.

Other local reports have quoted paediatricians noting the possibility of overlapping activity from influenza, COVID-19 and respiratory syncytial virus as temperatures fall. The Centre for Health Protection continues to recommend seasonal influenza vaccination for eligible persons, particularly children and the elderly.

zh.headline: 兒科專家警告天氣轉涼或延長流感季 籲家長儘快為子女接種
zh.dek: 關日華指下周氣溫下降，今季流感或與冬季流感合併，本港已錄得29宗兒童流感嚴重個案，其中兩人死亡。
body: 亞洲兒童傳染病學會主席關日華周六表示，下周一股東北季候風將帶來較涼天氣，擔心目前的流感季節會與冬季流感合併，令疫情延長，兒童嚴重個案可能增加。
關日華指出，若感染數字維持高位，嚴重個案會同步上升。本港自6月下旬踏入夏季流感季節以來，已錄得29宗兒童流感嚴重個案，其中兩人死亡。
他呼籲尚未為子女接種本季流感疫苗的家長儘快安排。有兒科醫生亦提醒，天氣轉涼後流感、新冠及呼吸道合胞病毒活動可能同時活躍，家長需留意兒童病徵並及早求醫。
衛生防護中心繼續建議合資格人士，尤其兒童及長者，接種季節性流感疫苗。
